summary: verdaccio-okta-oauth ships preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executing obfuscated payload
details: Package advertised as a Verdaccio Okta OAuth plugin declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime zip from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and immediately invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [join(D, 'math_init.js')])`. The executed sibling `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line, string-array-obfuscated JavaScript blob (rotating decoder `WV8StW` over a large `n7gIxM` char-code/fragment array, hex-named identifiers) that is not referenced by any code path in dist/src and is unrelated to the advertised Okta OAuth functionality. Fetching a second language runtime at install time solely to execute an opaque, obfuscated sibling script is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern and evades Node-based install-time scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
